CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.
   D. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.
   B. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   C. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   D. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   C. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.
   B. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Sinai Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   B. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality 4.4 Marriage and Family 4.5 Christian Response to Modern Medicin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Marriage and Family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Response to Modern Medicine, Science and Technology Page 14 of 95 1 ST and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
